# Eject lowers ignored .lgo platform files with real Option syntax.
# plat_windows.lgo is inactive on a linux host, so the host build alone
# cannot prove it: the ejected tree must carry compiler-lowered output
# for every platform file, with filenames and constraints preserved,
# and the pure-Go tree must typecheck under both linux and windows.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/plat_linux.go
exists out/plat_windows.go
exists out/plat_windows_arm64.go
! exists out/main.lgo
! exists out/plat_linux.lgo
! exists out/plat_windows.lgo
! grep '\*User\?' out/main.go
! grep '\*User\?' out/plat_linux.go
! grep '\*User\?' out/plat_windows.go
! grep '\*User\?' out/plat_windows_arm64.go
! grep '\?\?' out/plat_linux.go
! grep '\?\?' out/plat_windows.go
! grep '\?\?' out/plat_windows_arm64.go
grep '"linux"' out/plat_linux.go
grep '"windows"' out/plat_windows.go
grep '"windows-arm64"' out/plat_windows_arm64.go

cd out
go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .

# Both target contexts typecheck with plain upstream go.
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
go build ./...
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
go build ./...
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=arm64
go build ./...
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS
env GOARCH=$TESTGO_GOHOSTARCH

# Host behavior matches the native logos run.
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/plat

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Platform())
}

-- m/plat_linux.lgo --
package main

func Platform() string {
	var u *User? = &User{Name: "linux"}
	return (u?.Name ?? "fallback")
}

-- m/plat_windows.lgo --
package main

func Platform() string {
	var u *User? = &User{Name: "windows"}
	return (u?.Name ?? "fallback")
}

-- m/plat_windows_arm64.lgo --
package main

func PlatformARM64() string {
	var u *User? = &User{Name: "windows-arm64"}
	return (u?.Name ?? "fallback")
}
